items.name: ChestAppraisal
items.purpose: Appraises a drawn chest entry and rolls the damage it deals.
items.script:
IMPORT %chest%
SET loot = %chest%
SET base_damage = ROLL ((30-50))
SET bonus_damage = ROLL |2d6kh1|

IF base_damage > 45 THEN:
    SET rarity = "Legendary"
ELSE:
    SET rarity = "Common"
EXPOSE loot
EXPOSE base_damage
EXPOSE rarity
